tools.name: search_services
tools.description: Search the Pactum catalog of legal services in Uzbekistan (company registration, licences, trademarks, contracts, tax, disputes, migration, real estate and more). Use when the user describes a task they want done. Returns services with slug, price anchor and page URL; pass a slug to get_service or r

tools.name: get_service
tools.description: Full description of one Pactum service by slug (from search_services): what is included, price anchor, FAQ and page URL to cite.

tools.name: list_practice_areas
tools.description: Practice areas Pactum works in (slug + name). Pass a slug as practice_area in request_quote to route the request to the right lawyer.

tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Search Pactum articles explaining Uzbek law (company law, trademarks, tax, labour, licensing…). Returns titles, short summaries and URLs — cite them when answering the user.

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Send the user's legal task to Pactum lawyers; a lawyer reviews it and contacts the user with a price. tools.description: Book a 60-minute consultation with a Pactum lawyer, prepaid (the price is in the response; it is credited toward the service if the client orders it). findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_services, get_service, search_articles · Private data: request_quote · Public sink: request_quote.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_services, get_service, search_articles · Private data: request_quote · Public sink: request_quote

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
